chief_complaint: Advanced chronic kidney disease (stage 4) with evaluation for kidney transplantation and associated cardiovascular risk management.
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 72‑year‑old Black male with a long‑standing history of metabolic syndrome, obesity, and pre‑diabetes progressing to insulin therapy. Over the past several years his chronic kidney disease has advanced from stage 1 (2018) to stage 4 (2023) with proteinuria and anemia. He suffered an acute myocardial infarction in 2018, underwent coronary artery bypass grafting, and has persistent ischemic heart disease. Hypertension has been present since 2010 and is currently treated with hydrochlorothiazide. He is awaiting kidney transplantation since March 2023. Recent records note ongoing occupational stress and full‑time employment. Medication review was flagged in late 2024. Laboratory data are largely missing, including recent blood pressure, eGFR, lipid panel, and a likely erroneous HbA1c of 2.9 %.
